narr: Widespread thunderstorm activity occurred on June 21-22. Multiple small wildfires were started due to lightning strikes, and localized flooding was reported.
ev: Law enforcement reports roadway flooding, mostly in the #1 lane on the I-10 E near mile marker 18.
lsr: ROADWAY FLOODING, MOSTLY IN THE #1 LANE, ON THE I-10 E NEAR MILE MARKER 18.
CA CHP LAW ENFORCEMENT REPORTS FLOODING OF ROADWAY (CA 177). ONE OF THEIR PATROL VEHS SUSTAINED DAMAGE TRYING TO GET THRU TO AN ACCIDENT.
